Talent0_2Ability.name: EVA-02 Pilot
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can perform <buf ID=900088>[Synchronization]</buf> with ST. After actively attacking, if no damage is taken, DMG of the next active attack <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: EVA-02 Pilot
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can perform <buf ID=900088>[Synchronization]</buf> with ST. After actively attacking, if no damage is taken, DMG of the next active attack <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.
When deployed, <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> <color=#F74848>+10%</color>. If there are <color=#F74848>3</color> or more enemy STs within <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles, deals <color=#F74848>+15%</color> DMG.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101402.name: Cluster Fire
101402.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25</color>x DMG. Increases Hit Weighting of the part with the lowest HP by <color=#F74848>50</color>.

101403.name: Peerless Dodge
101403.SpecificEffects: When perfectly dodging an attack, restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat. Can trigger <color=#F74848>once</color> per turn.

101404.name: Leap Strike
101404.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> target within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles and strikes using a Polearm to deal <color=#F74848>1.25</color>x DMG to the target's Body, then remains on an empty tile within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring around the target.

101406.name: Wing Rake
101406.describe: Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. The target is unable to retaliate against this attack.

101407.name: Synchronous Strike
101407.SpecificEffects: Uses a Melee and Assault Weapon to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target of an ally's attack, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2</color>x DMG. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>twice</color> per turn.

101408.name: Mighty Throw
101408.describe:
Throws a Polearm at all targets within a <range type=1>4-tile line</range> (including flying targets), dealing <color=#F74848>1.5</color>x DMG to the first target hit, with the damage multiplier decreasing by <color=#F74848>0.4</color> when hitting each subsequent target. Can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before combat.
AP Cost <color=#F74848>+1</color> after each use. Can stack. Resets after taking action.

101409.name: Fracture
101409.describe: Uses a Polearm to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5</color>x DMG. If a part is destroyed successfully and both Arms remain undestroyed, deals <color=#F74848>0.25</color>x AoE DMG to targets within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring after combat.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101431.name: Eminence 1
101431.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, Crit Rate increases based on HP percentage, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

101434.name: Eminence 2
101434.SpecificEffects: Cannot be targeted by <buf ID=900023>[Quick Draw]</buf>, <buf ID=900013>[Vigilant Shot]</buf>, or <buf ID=900006>[Reaction Attack]</buf>.

101435.name: Eminence 3
101435.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat, if HP percentage is greater than or equal to the target's, Dodge Rate <color=#F74848>+25%</color>.

101436.name: Eminence 4
101436.SpecificEffects: At start of action, gain <buf ID=1014363>[Eminence]</buf>. This effect is removed upon taking damage.

101441.name: Prodigy 1
101441.SpecificEffects: At start of action, after <color=#F74848>2</color> turns, <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.

101444.name: Prodigy 2
101444.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> can also increase Final DMG, up to <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

101445.name: Prodigy 3
101445.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> can be further increased when dealing damage, and no longer decreases when taking damage.

101446.name: Prodigy 4
101446.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=1014820>[Sync Ratio]</buf> is greater than or equal to <color=#F74848>65%</color>, AP Regen <color=#F74848>+1</color>.
